pages.title: Royal Grid
pages.creator: Royal Grid
pages.description: Place crowns with logic in Royal Grid. Every row, column, and colored region needs exactly one, and crowns must remain separated even diagonally. Progress from five-by-five boards to nine-by-nine puzzles, using explanatory hints when a placement is difficult to deduce.

pages.title: Flat Touchdown
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Carry the ball toward the end zone in Flat Touchdown. Move sideways to dodge defenders as the field becomes increasingly crowded. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to steer, and swipe upward on touch devices for a boost.

pages.title: Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Renovate a home in Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor! Clear away rubbish and worn belongings before dragging furniture into the rooms. Experiment with the placement of decorative pieces to turn the emptied spaces into your own interiors.

pages.title: World Cup 2026 Soccer Game
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Play short head-to-head matches in World Cup 2026 Soccer Game. Choose a national side, defend your goal, and time shots to beat the other player. Challenge the computer or a friend using movement, jump, and separate shooting controls.

pages.title: Champions FC
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play through two quick halves in Champions FC. Dribble, pass, and time your kicks to get beyond defenders and score. React when possession changes and keep the ball inside the field during the fast-paced match.

pages.title: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Restore cartoon pictures in 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle. Move a block into the empty space to rearrange the scrambled image. Continue sliding the sections until animals, vehicles, or fairy-tale characters return to their complete arrangement.

pages.title: Thief Stick Puzzle Man Escape
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Solve unusual escape situations in Thief Stick Puzzle Man Escape. Help the stickman find routes through mazes, obtain treasure, and handle dangerous mechanisms. Examine each scene and choose the interactions that let the thief or another trapped character get clear.

pages.title: PuzzleJam
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear colored jelly pieces in PuzzleJam. Drag matching jellies together to combine them and complete the level's task in fewer moves. Use boosters and combinations when they help remove difficult groups from the board.

pages.title: HomeRun Derby
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Time batting swings in HomeRun Derby. Meet each pitch with the bat and try to drive the ball beyond the field for a home run. Build points through successful hits and see how many strong shots you can make in succession.

pages.title: Downhill Car Ride: Crash Test
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Set up destructive vehicle tests in Downhill Car Ride: Crash Test. Send dummies, cars, and motorcycles into collisions around an abandoned town. Demolish buildings and other objects to earn money, or experiment with explosives and last-second exits from the vehicle.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Obby Parkour
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Climb a meme-filled obstacle course in Italian Brainrot Obby Parkour. Choose a character, run between platforms, and time jumps toward the upper sections. Tackle the three-dimensional course alone or use the two-player mode to share the challenge.

pages.title: Shape Transform Blob Racing
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Adapt your runner to the route in Shape Transform Blob Racing. Switch the Blob between forms while it moves through obstacles. A ball shape helps with narrow passages, while a square suits flat sections, so choose the form needed for the next stretch.

pages.title: Ellie Christmas Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create three holiday looks in Ellie Christmas Makeup. Apply eye shadow, lipstick, patterned blush, and accessories to produce candy-cane, Christmas, and character-inspired designs. Try the available colors together as you prepare each themed makeover.

pages.title: Donut Run
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Control a rolling character in Donut Run. Move forward or backward to judge the gaps between traps and obstacles in each level. Use the left and right mouse buttons, or the corresponding sides of a touch screen, to adjust the movement.

pages.title: TicToc Urban Outfits
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style four online personalities in TicToc Urban Outfits. Explore their streetwear options, mix colors, and add accessories to create an outfit for each friend. Compare different combinations before settling on their urban looks.

pages.title: 1010 Elixir Alchemy
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect marked ingredients by clearing lines in 1010 Elixir Alchemy. Place shaped blocks on the ten-by-ten board and complete rows or columns to remove elixirs. Gather them all across sixty puzzles before a crowded grid prevents further placements.

pages.title: Sweet Merge
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Drop desserts into the play area in Sweet Merge. Bring identical jellies, cakes, or candies together to create a larger sweet. Consider where the new piece will land so you can keep building bigger combinations.

pages.title: Valentines Makeup Trends
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Try candy-colored beauty looks in Valentines Makeup Trends. Choose makeup for the social media models and coordinate the details into a fantasy-inspired design. Explore the available shades to prepare the characters for their Valentine's evening.

pages.title: Christmas Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find changes between festive scenes in Christmas Spot the Difference. Each picture pair contains five to ten differences, and incorrect clicks remove one hundred points. Finish before time expires to earn an additional time bonus.

pages.title: Skibidi Hero.IO
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Fight waves and grow stronger in Skibidi Hero.IO. Move around the arena to shoot enemies while avoiding their attacks. Collect the points they leave behind and choose one of three power upgrades whenever the hero gains a level.

pages.title: Only Up Gravity Parkour 3D
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Climb suspended objects in Only Up Gravity Parkour 3D. Jump across discarded carts, garage debris, road signs, and other obstacles to gain height. Reach red flags to save your progress before continuing toward the next elevated section.

pages.title: Moto Madness
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Ride an endless busy highway in Moto Madness. Steer the motorcycle around traffic and travel as far as possible without a crash. Collect coins to improve your options and work toward a selection of eight bikes.

pages.title: Drag Race!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Beat another car in Drag Race! Time your inputs accurately to improve the rewards from each race, and activate nitro when useful. Spend earned coins on vehicle upgrades or buy a different car for later contests.

pages.title: Insane Moto 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Complete fifteen stunt courses in Insane Moto 3D. Steer the motorbike through traps and difficult track sections while keeping it under control. Use the arrow keys for movement and the space bar to brake as you approach a hazard.

pages.title: Infinity Golf
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Reach the hole with fewer strokes in Infinity Golf. Hold and release the mouse button to set a shot's power, and aim around obstacles before swinging. Try the different courses and adjust your next attempt to the ball's position.

pages.title: Zombie Survivor Fight
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build a stronger defense in Zombie Survivor Fight. Use a machine gun against approaching zombies, add guards, and set traps around the territory. Improve weapons so the defenses can stop the growing assault and keep the survivor alive.

pages.title: Maze of infection
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Escape a laboratory overrun with undead in Maze of infection. Search twelve floors for a way out while using collected weapons against pursuing monsters. Move with WASD, aim and fire with the mouse, and scroll to change your equipment.

pages.title: Mouse 2 Player Moto Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race small riders through city tracks in Mouse 2 Player Moto Racing. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, use Shift for nitro, and reset with R if the vehicle gets stuck. Share the racing challenge in the two-player mode.

pages.title: Grenade Hit Stickman
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Throw explosives along chosen arcs in Grenade Hit Stickman. Hold and drag the mouse or swipe to set a trajectory toward enemies and their structures. Use the blast to break defenses and clear each destructive level.

pages.title: Parkour Climb and Jump
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Explore a city through athletic moves in Parkour Climb and Jump. Run across rooftops, climb walls, slide beneath barriers, and jump between buildings. Use the bungee from suitable platforms to reach distant areas and link more tricks together.

pages.title: Word Search
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Find listed answers in Word Search. Scan the letter grid for each required word and mark it when you recognize the sequence. Try to complete the full list faster on each new puzzle.

pages.title: Hunter Assassin 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Eliminate armed patrols in Hunter Assassin 2. Direct the assassin around enemies while keeping out of dangerous firing positions. Gather gold, stars, and diamonds to improve speed and strength as you clear more than twenty levels.

pages.title: Push Balls
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Match the moving ball's color in Push Balls. Rotate the pairs at the top and bottom so the center ball touches the correct color on each pass. React when its shade changes and keep up as its movement accelerates.

pages.title: Riddles of Squid
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Help a contestant pursue the prize in Riddles of Squid. Work through the game's challenges using the heroine's available actions. After succeeding, choose new clothes, hairstyles, and makeup to complete her reward look.

pages.title: Special Forces Sniper
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take aimed shots in Special Forces Sniper. Tap to fire at the targets in each of twenty shooting levels. Judge the shot before releasing it and work through the remaining sniper assignments.

pages.title: Mahjong Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear exposed matching tiles in Mahjong Quest. Remove the full arrangement or find its special pieces while aiming for fast completion medals. Unlock further levels and use the earned tools to help with more difficult layouts.

pages.title: Crazy Gravity Space
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Repair a stranded rocket in Crazy Gravity Space. Guide the astronaut through fifteen platform levels, gathering energized items while avoiding spikes and electrical machines. Use changes in gravity to reach new routes and return the spacecraft to working order.

pages.title: Breaking Fall Jigsaw
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Lower a lift safely in Breaking Fall Jigsaw. Guide the elevator past obstacles during its descent and keep the passengers clear of collisions. Reach the ground to rescue the falling character and complete the stage.

pages.title: Ludo Master
pages.creator: Game Debut
pages.description: Race pawns around the board in Ludo Master. Roll the dice and move toward home while competing with the other players. Adjust optional rules, including safe spaces and extra turns on particular rolls, to choose the version you want to play.

pages.title: GTR Drift & Stunt
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Build a driving score in GTR Drift & Stunt. Explore the city in a GTR, perform jumps, and drift around its streets. Use boosts or slow motion when useful, and change the camera or car color during the drive.

pages.title: City School Bus Driving
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Take a bus along school routes in City School Bus Driving. Handle off-road sections and highway travel while working to arrive on time. Use the arrow keys to steer the large vehicle through the driving assignments.

pages.title: Fashion Monsters Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Clear matching creatures in Fashion Monsters Match 3. Form rows of at least three same-colored pieces to add points and keep the side meter from falling. Continue finding combinations before that meter reaches its lower limit.

pages.title: Two Stunts
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Try eight sports cars in Two Stunts. Explore an arena, a natural setting, or an urban map, using ramps and terrain for driving tricks. Collect coins and avoid the police to unlock the locked vehicles, with separate controls available for two players.

pages.title: Plof
pages.creator: Salvatore DePalo
pages.description: Burst the floating targets in Plof. Click bubbles to pop them and clear the play area. Some tougher bubbles require two or three clicks, so keep tapping a resistant target until it breaks.

pages.title: Number Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Follow an increasing sequence in Number Jump. Jump onto numbered positions in order from the smallest value to the largest. Look for the next required number before moving toward the finish line.

pages.title: Sports bike simulator Drift 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Ride a sports motorcycle in Sports bike simulator Drift 3D. Start the engine, accelerate, and steer through the riding environment. Use WASD to control the bike as you practice turns and speed management.

pages.title: Diver Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Free a trapped scuba diver in Diver Escape. Search the house for concealed objects and clues, then use them to solve its escape puzzles. Combine what you discover to open the route out for the diver.

pages.title: Mob War
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Build the city's largest crowd in Mob War. Move through the streets to gather people and strengthen your following. Use the growing mob against opposing groups as you work to dominate the town.

pages.title: Make 5
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Merge groups of three in Make 5. Place matching numbers and colors beside each other horizontally or vertically to combine them. Rotate the offered blocks before setting them down to prepare useful groups within the grid.

pages.title: Micro Tank Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Outlast opposing vehicles in Micro Tank Wars. Aim precise shots through fifteen arenas featuring moving walls and maze-like layouts. Play against the computer or a friend and keep damage low, since the combined score across the levels decides the winner.

pages.title: Amazing Car Wash
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Clean a dirty vehicle in Amazing Car Wash. Use the mouse to handle the washing activities and work over the car's surface. Complete the cleaning steps to finish its visit to the wash.

pages.title: Crazy Kick!
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide the football toward the goal in Crazy Kick! Slide to control its route around people trying to block the shot. Score points and collect coins to unlock different skins for later attempts.

pages.title: You Drive I shoot
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Survive a dangerous road trip in You Drive I shoot. Steer Mark and Katie's vehicle past zombies and uncontrolled self-driving cars. Work through fifteen post-apocalyptic driving levels using keyboard controls or the on-screen buttons.

pages.title: Santa Claus Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Gather presents in Santa Claus Adventure. Move through the route collecting as many gifts as you can while avoiding the ice blocks. Use mouse or touch input to keep Santa clear of the obstacles.

pages.title: Donny
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Free captured monkeys in Donny. Move left and right and shoot at their human captors across five levels. Use A and D with the space bar, or the available touch controls, to carry out the rescue.

pages.title: FZ Knife Up
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Time upward throws in FZ Knife Up. Click to launch the knife and judge its route before the next attempt. Keep landing successful throws to build a larger score.

pages.title: Magical Driving
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Dodge traffic across changing environments in Magical Driving. Tap to make the vehicle jump while collecting stars for points. Transformation pickups switch it between a truck, boat, and airplane, changing the drive as you continue.

pages.title: Cute Animals Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find paired pictures in Cute Animals Memory. Turn over tiles and remember the revealed animals to locate each identical match. Clear four boards while trying to complete them in fewer moves.

pages.title: A Class Sedan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six car images in A Class Sedan Puzzle. Pick a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout for the chosen picture. Move the pieces into position until the full sedan scene is complete.

pages.title: Spell School
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Practice naming illustrated objects in Spell School. Look at the picture and use the mouse to select the letters needed for its spelling. Complete the word before moving on to the next object.

pages.title: Jurassic Dino Transport Truck
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Transport prehistoric animals in Jurassic Dino Transport Truck. Drive a heavy cargo vehicle through the park and carry dinosaurs toward their zoo destination. Use WASD or the arrow keys to handle the truck across the route.

pages.title: Super Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six performance-car pictures in Super Cars Puzzle. Select a layout containing 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, then restore the complete image. Use the bodywork and background details to guide each placement.

pages.title: BTS Fruits Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a fruit picture in BTS Fruits Coloring. Apply the colors you prefer with mouse or touch controls and work through its outlined sections. Create your own palette for the selected illustration.

pages.title: EG Crazy Runner
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Jump through a busy street in EG Crazy Runner. Clear cars, tires, and bombs while gathering coins and food along the road. Avoid landing on explosives or colliding with traffic as you chase more distance and points.

pages.title: BTS Dinosaur Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Decorate prehistoric creatures in BTS Dinosaur Coloring Book. Select an outlined image and use the brush to apply your preferred colors. Fill its different sections to complete a dinosaur picture in your own palette.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Paper Note 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play a drawn-board contest in Tic Tac Toe Paper Note 2. Place marks to form a line of three and prevent the other side doing the same. Challenge a friend or the computer with mouse or touch controls.

pages.title: Cute Ball 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Keep the character clear of attackers in Cute Ball 2. Use the arrow keys to steer the ball as enemies approach. Watch for black-hole hazards as well as charging foes while trying to survive the play area.

pages.title: My Dream Hospital
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Treat patients in My Dream Hospital. Use the mouse to select medical tools and follow the game's care prompts. Work through injuries, wound cleaning, and stitching activities to complete each hospital treatment.

pages.title: Stickman Killer Top Gun Shots
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Face armed opponents in Stickman Killer Top Gun Shots. Aim and shoot to eliminate every enemy while watching your health bar. Use the limited ammunition carefully as snipers and tougher adversaries join the fight.

pages.title: Cute Little Horse Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Unlock horse pictures in Cute Little Horse Jigsaw. Assemble the first image to earn in-game money, then spend enough to buy another puzzle. Choose among three difficulties for each of ten pictures, with harder boards paying more.

pages.title: Ducky Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Collect jungle treasure together in Ducky Adventure. Guide two automatically moving ducks around traps and enemies, then bring the gold to its chest. Use each player's movement and firing controls to cooperate through the platform routes.

pages.title: Vampires Lore
pages.creator: Hack TheREALITY
pages.description: Battle as a supernatural fighter in Vampires Lore. Use combat skills and magical abilities to defeat other players across two modes and two maps. Move through the battlefield and choose opportunities to attack rival vampires.

pages.title: My Pet Clinic
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Care for several animal species in My Pet Clinic. Remove ticks from dogs, apply cats' eye drops, clean turtle shells, and help injured parrots with the appropriate tools. Use hints when needed to complete each pet's treatment.

pages.title: Space Chasers
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Chase pirates through matching puzzles in Space Chasers. Connect at least three identical symbols on the hexagonal board to make your task force attack. Longer chains unleash stronger firepower, helping stop enemy ships before they escape.

pages.title: Drag Racing
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Beat opposing cars in Drag Racing. Build race earnings and use them to purchase a different vehicle or improve your current one. Strengthen the car's performance as you work toward more wins.

pages.title: Gold Miner Classic
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Gather valuable ore in Gold Miner Classic. Send the mining grabber toward gold and pull its catches back to earn money. Spend on improvements that help you collect more valuable loads during later attempts.

pages.title: My Birthday Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare Cindy for guests in My Birthday Party. Choose her birthday dress and finish the room's decorations before the celebration begins. Coordinate the clothing and party details to get everything ready.

pages.title: Princess In Circus Show
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Style three performers in Princess In Circus Show. Choose stage outfits for Elsa, Ariel, and Rapunzel, then help with their circus performance. Prepare each princess for her part in the day's show.

pages.title: Easter Time Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search seasonal scenes in Easter Time Hidden Stars. Find all five concealed stars in a picture to open the next level. Examine small details in the artwork and select each star you uncover.

pages.title: Form destroyer
pages.creator: Two Hands Lab
pages.description: Adapt to incoming figures in Form destroyer. Change your form to match the shape approaching you so it can pass safely. Keep recognizing and selecting the required designs to survive for as long as possible.

pages.title: Electrio Master
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Link opposite charges in Electrio Master. Connect every electron while alternating positive and negative nodes along the route. Keep the joining lines from overlapping as you plan a complete path through the arrangement.

pages.title: Platforms Alien Jump
pages.creator: MomentsGames
pages.description: Hop between ledges in Platforms Alien Jump. Tap the left or right side to choose the next platform and keep moving before time expires. Rainbow platforms change the alien's color, while rainbow clouds change both the character and the platforms.

pages.title: Unihorn
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fire from a unicorn's horn in Unihorn. Aim with the mouse and hold to shoot at approaching flying enemies. Stop them from filling the play area, and explore the shop's horn, clothing, and environment options as you progress.

pages.title: High School Couples!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Ellie and Annie prepare in High School Couples! Choose dresses and other outfit pieces for the two students as they get ready to meet their boyfriends. Try the available clothing combinations to complete each girl's look.

pages.title: The Weeding Shop
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Style three brides in The Weeding Shop. Pick Elsa, Anna, or Barbie, apply makeup, and choose her wedding dress and finishing details. Submit the completed look for the game's fashion opinion after making your selections.
